title: Is a Market Reset Coming?
speaker: Chris and Nick (A1 Trading)

macro_themes.view: Hot CPI and PPI prints mean inflation will stick around longer, making the Fed's job harder.
AI capex without visible ROI for end users could trigger a healthy but painful reset in expectations that drags the market down.
Support for markets may fade after the midterms, opening the door to a post-election move lower; contested results possible.
Yields cooled after growth fears, but the bond bid is seen as a short-term play and yields likely stay sticky.

calls.reason: Semis concentrated AI run could round-trip like ARKK 2022; possible XABCD harmonic retrace back toward Liberation Day levels.
calls.quote: I'm very cautious like investing long SMH without having a game plan to maybe ride this thing all the way down to like 200.

calls.reason: Falling wedge with higher lows on VIX; election-related catalyst within 30-45 days could spark a volatility spike.
calls.quote: it doesn't take much for the Vix to go from a 16 to a 30.

calls.condition: if post-midterm support fades / AI expectations reset
calls.reason: Kitchen sink thrown at markets before midterms may subside afterward; AI ROI disappointment could reset expectations.
calls.quote: could you actually get kind of a post midterm election type of move lower? That's that's something I'm thinking about.

calls.reason: Bond rally after hot CPI is a short-term fake out; inflation environment keeps yields sticky.
calls.quote: I don't know if the yields are going to stay lower. I think they're still going to be sticky.

notes: Two-host weekend chat; no date stated, listing date used. SMH 200/170 is a zone they'd position for, not a firm target. TNX bias inferred from 'yields sticky'.
